findings.heading: Suggested packages / Pacotes sugeridos
findings.proposition: The English says sub-packages are marked in the code by an INDENT plus a hash; the Portuguese says they are marked by a 'travessao' (a dash) plus a hashtag, and no dash marker exists in the code chunk.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader scans the pacman::p_load() block for a dash character to identify packages bundled inside another package. No dash is present, so the reader cannot apply the rule and may fail to see that the indented commented lines (#dplyr, #ggplot2, ...) are the bundled packages.
